gotchas: English signup: on https://www.ana.co.jp/en/us/ click the header 'Join', then 'Join ANA Mileage Club', which opens the 'New Membership Registration' form in a POPUP (waitForPopup). The ja/jp page in signupUrl asks for Kanji names.

passwordSetBySite: no. The form needs TWO secrets: a Web password (8 to 16 half-width letters and digits; create the login with maxLength 16 and noSymbols) AND a required 'AMC password' of exactly 4 half-width digits (+ re-enter). The vault has no token for the second numeric PIN, so the signup cannot be completed unattended; an agent must not invent one.

Also required: romaji Family/First name (23 characters max in total), Gender, Date of birth as yyyy/mm/dd text, mailing address with 'Outside of Japan' residence, a home phone number, email typed twice, card type, and the terms checkbox.
